items.docs: Returns GraphRAG configuration including allowed LLM models for graph building.

info.name: Build a knowledge graph for a collection.

params.name: collection_id
params.description: The collection ID to build the graph for.

items.docs: Triggers an asynchronous job that extracts entities and relationships from document chunks to build a knowledge graph using LightRAG. Returns 409 Conflict if a build is already in progress.

info.name: Get graph build status for a collection.

items.docs: Returns the current knowledge graph build status and metadata.

info.name: Delete the knowledge graph for a collection.

params.name: collection_id
params.description: The collection whose graph should be deleted.

items.docs:
Tears down the collection's knowledge graph: removes the stored
tarball from object storage, drops the in-memory per-collection
lock and event loop, removes the local LightRAG cache directory,
and resets graph_status to 'none'. The collection itself is
unaffected. Auto-RAG selection will revert to normal RAG until
a new graph is built.
